title: Operator admin console access review and deprovisioning proof depth
boundarySummary: USF-217 makes every in-scope operator/admin/control-plane surface disposition machine-checkable for the selected closure tier. It does not prove recurring review execution, provider-console revocation, identity lifecycle integration, public exposure, environment promotion, or production operator readiness.
